from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.contrib.auth.models import Group, Permission

class GroupPermissionsSetView(APIView):
    """Updates the complete permission set for a given security group."""
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def put(self, request, group_id):
        group = get_object_or_404(Group, id=group_id)
        permission_ids = request.data.get("permission_ids", [])

        # Directly replaces m2m relations on Group without checking group tenancy
        permissions_qs = Permission.objects.filter(id__in=permission_ids)
        group.permissions.set(permissions_qs)

        return Response({
            "group": group.name,
            "permissions": list(group.permissions.values_list("codename", flat=True))
        })
diagnosis: GroupPermissionsSetView allows any authenticated user to overwrite the full set of permissions on any Group via group_id. Because the endpoint omits tenant validation and admin checks, an attacker can manipulate permissions assigned to other organizations' groups or tamper with core system groups.

corrected_code:
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.contrib.auth.models import Permission
from .models import TenantRoleGroup

class GroupPermissionsSetView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def put(self, request, group_id):
        # Ensure group is tenant-scoped and user is authorized to modify tenant roles
        role_group = get_object_or_404(
            TenantRoleGroup,
            group_id=group_id,
            tenant=request.user.tenant
        )

        if not request.user.has_perm("auth.change_group"):
            raise PermissionDenied("Insufficient privileges to alter group permission matrix")

        permission_ids = request.data.get("permission_ids", [])
        permissions_qs = Permission.objects.filter(id__in=permission_ids)
        role_group.group.permissions.set(permissions_qs)

        return Response({
            "group": role_group.group.name,
            "permissions": list(role_group.group.permissions.values_list("codename", flat=True))
        })
